data.content_ref: inline:The STATE_OF_THE_THEORY dossier (0e26d6be54fd) inherits its diagnostic framing from the BASIN REPORT dossier (0f99efbab8a4), as both share the mechanism of mapping conjecture circles to repertoire exhaustion and refuted-attractor dynamics; this relation is refuted if the state-of-the-theory document establishes its diagnostics independently of the attractor-repertoire model or explicitly denies the basin report's exhaustion terminology as a foundational reference.
